parties.respondent: The State of Madhya Pradesh & Ors.

summary: The appeals challenged the High Court's decision allowing recovery of excess pay granted under a circular dated 23.05.2009, which was later withdrawn. The circular had provided notional pay fixation and financial benefits to medical specialists from 2008, but was revoked in 2012 due to lack of authority and financial burden. The Supreme Court upheld the withdrawal of the circular but ruled against recovery of excess payments with interest, holding that the employees were not at fault and the error lay with the State. Recovery from pensionary benefits of retired doctors was deemed unjust. Pay fixation and pensions to be recalculated as per the 2008 order, excluding the 2009 circular.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Punjab and others Vs. Rafiq Masih, (2015) 4 SCC 334
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed. Recovery of excess amount paid under the circular dated 23.05.2009, with interest, quashed. Pay fixation and pension to be determined as per the order dated 26.08.2008, as if the 2009 circular was never issued. No order as to costs.
